TestReversedQueriesMemoryUsage::test_mem.description: 2 nodes (one per rack), smp=1, memory=512M, RF=2. 10 workers write a ~1GB single partition (100k rows x 10KB) at CL=ALL. Then `ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200` (~2MB) must succeed, return 200 rows and be split into >1 page; and its page count must equal the forward `ORDER BY id LIMIT 200` page count. Guards that reversed reads of partitions larger than shard memory don't accumulate the whole partition (scylladb#9134) and use the same page size as forward reads (scylladb PR #9815).
